summary:
The big ship earlier this week was the Currently panel on the home page — it now pulls directly from the dashboard JSON as a single source of truth rather than duplicating content. That meant wiring a live data fetch into the home layout and making sure the two sections stay in sync without manual edits.

The rest of the week has been polish: footer updated to call out human + agent authorship, booking CTAs added throughout the site, home copy tightened with a cleaner identity kicker line. The 3 a.m. claim that had been sitting in the hero copy for a while finally got cut.

On the Hermes side, the daily dashboard cron is running stably. Spotify credentials were refreshed and persisted earlier in the week after a token rotation edge case surfaced during a manual run. (snapshot stale, last sync unknown)

highlights.oneLiner: Currently panel on home page wired to dashboard JSON — single source of truth, no manual sync.
Home copy pass: identity kicker updated, stale claims removed, booking CTAs added throughout.
Daily dashboard cron stable; Spotify token rotation edge case caught and patched.
